title: Debugging and sanitizing tools: address, undefined behaviour and memory diagnostics
learningObjectives: Explain the concept and its constraints.
Trace the example and reason about its data flow.
Identify complexity, boundary or safety considerations.
Apply the concept in a tested C program.

understand.concept: Debug and sanitizer builds can detect classes of defects such as out-of-bounds access, use-after-free, invalid shifts and some undefined behaviour. Common options include address and undefined-behaviour sanitizers on supported compiler/runtime combinations.
understand.whyItMatters: Dynamic diagnostics catch defects on executed paths; they cannot prove that every path is correct or replace careful reasoning and testing.
understand.analogy: Treat an algorithm or data structure as a set of operations that must preserve a clearly stated contract.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy does not replace formal complexity analysis, C object rules or algorithm preconditions.

explain.narrative:
Debug and sanitizer builds can detect classes of defects such as out-of-bounds access, use-after-free, invalid shifts and some undefined behaviour. Common options include address and undefined-behaviour sanitizers on supported compiler/runtime combinations.

Before implementation, state input constraints, empty-case behaviour, ownership and invariants. Compile with warnings and test representative, boundary and failure cases.

examples.title: Focused C example
examples.explanation: The command requests debug information and runtime instrumentation where supported. The program itself performs a valid access; a deliberately invalid test can be used to observe a diagnostic in a controlled environment.

practise.guidedTask: Distinguish a compiler warning from a runtime sanitizer report.
practise.independentTask: Run a small test suite under sanitizers and document which executed paths were covered.
hints: Sanitizer availability and behaviour depend on compiler, operating system and runtime support.
A clean sanitizer run does not prove absence of all undefined behaviour.
Keep test cases deterministic and reproducible.
